
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/axing/p/19884352" title="发布于 2026-04-17 16:32">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">玩转控件:封装个带图片的Label控件</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>话不多说，先看效果</strong></p>
<p><strong>　　&nbsp;经常做工控上位机或者MES的都知道，UI虽然没有要求那么高，实用就好，但是能美化下winform UI 有时候也能给客户增加几分好感，给枯燥乏味的工作增添一抹颜色</strong></p>
<p><strong><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260414114040499-649206743.png" alt="ScreenShot_2026-04-14_105733_321" loading="lazy"></strong></p>
<p><strong data-brushtype="text">起因</strong></p>
<p><strong data-brushtype="text">　　&nbsp;为了给枯燥UI添加点颜色，前后也找了很多UI控件，免费里面效果最好（实际很拉跨）的也就RealTaiizor了，但是集成过的同学们都应该知道，稍微后台逻辑复杂一点，耗时就一点的，加载起来贼慢，而且很容易整个控件崩溃，一个大大的红X</strong></p>
<p><strong data-brushtype="text"><strong data-brushtype="text">ImageLabel</strong></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　　惹不起，还躲不起吗？RealTaiizor效果好看，那就按照它的效果，重新封装一个简化版控件，能满足实际业务需求即可！开始动手，继承Label控件，扩展图片显示位置，图片大小，图片和文字间距，图片更改事件等等功能</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202510/116076-20251007183726557-172866994.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>[ToolboxBitmap(typeof<span>(Label))]
publicpartialclassImageLabel : Label
 {
     private<span> Image _image;
     privateint _imageWidth = 32<span>;
     privateint _imageHeight = 32<span>;
     privateint _imageTextSpacing = 5<span>;
     private ContentAlignment _imageAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft;  // 默认图片左中对齐
<span>
     publicImageLabel()
     {
         this.DoubleClick +=<span> ImageLabel_DoubleClick;
         // 确保控件支持透明背景（如果需要）
         this.SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor | ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, true<span>);
     }

     #region Public Properties<span>

     [Category("Appearance"<span>)]
     [Description("The image displayed."<span>)]
     public<span> Image Image
     {
         get { return<span> _image; }
         set<span>
         {
             _image =<span> value;
             Invalidate();
             OnImageChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
         }
     }

     [Category("Appearance"<span>)]
     [DefaultValue(32<span>)]
     publicint ImageWidth
     {
         get { return<span> _imageWidth; }
         set<span>
         {
             _imageWidth =<span> value;
             Invalidate();
         }
     }

     [Category("Appearance"<span>)]
     [DefaultValue(32<span>)]
     publicint ImageHeight
     {
         get { return<span> _imageHeight; }
         set<span>
         {
             _imageHeight =<span> value;
             Invalidate();
         }
     }

     [Category("Appearance"<span>)]
     [DefaultValue(5<span>)]
     publicint ImageTextSpacing
     {
         get { return<span> _imageTextSpacing; }
         set<span>
         {
             _imageTextSpacing =<span> value;
             Invalidate();
         }
     }

     [Category("Appearance"<span>)]
     [Description("Determines the alignment of the image within the control."<span>)]
     [DefaultValue(ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft)]
     public<span> ContentAlignment ImageAlign
     {
         get { return<span> _imageAlign; }
         set<span>
         {
             _imageAlign =<span> value;
             Invalidate();
         }
     }

     #endregion

     #region Events<span>

     [Category("Property Changed"<span>)]
     [Description("Occurs when the Image property value changes."<span>)]
     publicevent EventHandler ImageChanged;

     protectedvirtualvoidOnImageChanged(EventArgs e)
     {
         ImageChanged?.Invoke(this<span>, e);
     }

     #endregion

     #region Overridden Methods<span>

     protectedoverridevoidOnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
     {
         // 计算图片矩形（根据 ImageAlign 对齐）
         Rectangle imageRect =<span> GetImageRectangle();

         // 计算文字矩形（自动避开图片区域）
         Rectangle textRect =<span> GetTextRectangle(imageRect);

         // 绘制图片
         if (Image != null<span>)
         {
             e.Graphics.DrawImage(Image, imageRect);
         }

         // 绘制文字
         TextFormatFlags flags = TextFormatFlags.WordBreak |<span> TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter;
         // 根据文字对齐方式调整 flags（可选，这里简单使用左对齐）
         flags |=<span> TextFormatFlags.Left;
         TextRenderer.DrawText(e.Graphics, this.Text, this.Font, textRect, this<span>.ForeColor, flags);
     }

     #endregion

     #region Private Layout Methods

     ///&lt;summary&gt;
     /// 根据 ImageAlign 计算图片的绘制位置
     ///&lt;/summary&gt;
     private<span> Rectangle GetImageRectangle()
     {
         int x = 0, y = 0<span>;
         int clientWidth = this<span>.ClientSize.Width;
         int clientHeight = this<span>.ClientSize.Height;

         // 水平对齐
         switch<span> (ImageAlign)
         {
             case<span> ContentAlignment.TopLeft:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.BottomLeft:
                 x =<span> Padding.Left;
                 break<span>;
             case<span> ContentAlignment.TopCenter:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
                 x = (clientWidth - ImageWidth) / 2<span>;
                 break<span>;
             case<span> ContentAlignment.TopRight:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
                 x = clientWidth - Padding.Right -<span> ImageWidth;
                 break<span>;
         }

         // 垂直对齐
         switch<span> (ImageAlign)
         {
             case<span> ContentAlignment.TopLeft:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.TopCenter:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.TopRight:
                 y =<span> Padding.Top;
                 break<span>;
             case<span> ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.MiddleRight:
                 y = (clientHeight - ImageHeight) / 2<span>;
                 break<span>;
             case<span> ContentAlignment.BottomLeft:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.BottomCenter:
             case<span> ContentAlignment.BottomRight:
                 y = clientHeight - Padding.Bottom -<span> ImageHeight;
                 break<span>;
         }

         // 边界检查，确保不超出控件范围
         x = Math.Max(Padding.Left, Math.Min(x, clientWidth - Padding.Right -<span> ImageWidth));
         y = Math.Max(Padding.Top, Math.Min(y, clientHeight - Padding.Bottom -<span> ImageHeight));

         returnnew Rectangle(x, y, ImageWidth, ImageHeight);
     }

     ///&lt;summary&gt;
     /// 计算文字区域，自动避开图片区域
     ///&lt;/summary&gt;
     private<span> Rectangle GetTextRectangle(Rectangle imageRect)
     {
         Rectangle textRect = new<span> Rectangle(Padding.Left, Padding.Top,
             this.ClientSize.Width - Padding.Left -<span> Padding.Right,
             this.ClientSize.Height - Padding.Top -<span> Padding.Bottom);

         // 如果图片为空，直接返回全区域
         if (Image == null) return<span> textRect;

         // 根据图片对齐方式，判断文字应该放在图片的哪一侧
         // 简单策略：如果图片在左边，文字放在右边；图片在右边，文字放在左边；图片在顶部/底部则文字放在剩余区域
         // 更完善的方案可以自由组合，这里演示最常见的几种
         bool imageLeft = (ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft || ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.TopLeft || ImageAlign ==<span> ContentAlignment.BottomLeft);
         bool imageRight = (ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.MiddleRight || ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.TopRight || ImageAlign ==<span> ContentAlignment.BottomRight);
         bool imageTop = (ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.TopCenter || ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.TopLeft || ImageAlign ==<span> ContentAlignment.TopRight);
         bool imageBottom = (ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.BottomCenter || ImageAlign == ContentAlignment.BottomLeft || ImageAlign ==<span> ContentAlignment.BottomRight);

         if<span> (imageLeft)
         {
             int textLeft = imageRect.Right +<span> ImageTextSpacing;
             textRect = new<span> Rectangle(textLeft, textRect.Y,
                 this.ClientSize.Width - textLeft -<span> Padding.Right,
                 textRect.Height);
         }
         elseif (imageRight)
         {
             int textRight = imageRect.Left -<span> ImageTextSpacing;
             textRect = new<span> Rectangle(Padding.Left, textRect.Y,
                 Math.Max(0, textRight -<span> Padding.Left),
                 textRect.Height);
         }
         elseif (imageTop)
         {
             int textTop = imageRect.Bottom +<span> ImageTextSpacing;
             textRect = new<span> Rectangle(textRect.X, textTop,
                 textRect.Width,
                 this.ClientSize.Height - textTop -<span> Padding.Bottom);
         }
         elseif (imageBottom)
         {
             int textBottom = imageRect.Top -<span> ImageTextSpacing;
             textRect = new<span> Rectangle(textRect.X, Padding.Top,
                 textRect.Width,
                 Math.Max(0, textBottom -<span> Padding.Top));
         }
         else// 居中情况，文字覆盖图片区域（或简单放在下方）
<span>         {
             // 如果图片居中，文字默认放在图片下方
             int textTop = imageRect.Bottom +<span> ImageTextSpacing;
             textRect = new<span> Rectangle(textRect.X, textTop,
                 textRect.Width,
                 this.ClientSize.Height - textTop -<span> Padding.Bottom);
         }

         // 确保文字矩形有效
         if (textRect.Width &lt; 0) textRect.Width = 0<span>;
         if (textRect.Height &lt; 0) textRect.Height = 0<span>;

         return<span> textRect;
     }

     #endregion

     #region Double-click to upload image<span>

     privatevoidImageLabel_DoubleClick(object<span> sender, EventArgs e)
     {
         using (OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new<span> OpenFileDialog())
         {
             openFileDialog.Title = "请选择一张图片"<span>;
             openFileDialog.Filter = "图像文件|*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.png;*.gif;*.bmp"<span>;
             if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() ==<span> DialogResult.OK)
             {
                 this.Image =<span> Image.FromFile(openFileDialog.FileName);
             }
         }
     }

     #endregion<span>
 }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>结束</strong></p>
